title: Customs Support
description: customssupport.com Revenue $389.4 Million IZD GmbH Europe's largest customs brokerage network, founded with headquarters in the Netherlands and operating 50 plus offices across 14 countries with over 1,600 employees. Its German subsidiary IZD GmbH is based in Duisburg, Europe's largest inland port, providing 24/7 customs clearance for automotive, electronics, pharmaceutical and e-commerce clients. Services cover import and export clearance, transit procedures, tariff classification, bonded warehousing, AEO certification and export controls. The group is backed by European private equity fund Castik Capital and serves over 5,000 clients. Its digital platform at customssupport.com offers EDI integration, real-time tracking and customs data analytics. Estimated group revenue is 300 to 500 million euro with recent additions including Brexit advisory and preferential trade consulting.
